status: fixed before corrected-ROI model results; previously inspected development recordings, not blind testing

data.known_independence_limit: 2 recordings of the same physical bearing per class, 1 training recording per class per fold

radar_training.input: 128 frame_shape features, same feature definition as previous iteration
radar_training.loss: CE + recording mean standardized MSE + 0.1 contrast + 0.5 temperature2 KD

rotllm_input: unchanged primary raw_rms001 from previous iteration; no new test-based preprocessing selection
stitching: contact TRAIN-only two StandardScalers and weighted Ridge alpha1; ReLU; frozen corrected-ROI Bear students; original15 and separate contact4 readouts both reported

physical_readouts.purpose: falsifiable check for information beyond class prototypes, not automatic proof of rich knowledge
teacher_spaces: third official pretrained teacher if input contract is valid
targets: log RMS of XYZ-averaged 20-800Hz band-limited acceleration
log crest factor of the same signal
log Pearson kurtosis of the same signal
physical_readouts.filter: per-axis fourth-order Butterworth 20-800Hz SOS zero-phase at verified 4000Hz; remove per-axis mean; discard first and last 0.1 seconds for descriptor computation
physical_readouts.spectral_descriptor: Welch 512-point segments on trimmed band-passed window, integrate PSD in fixed intervals, average axis powers before ratios
physical_readouts.readout_fit: recording-balanced contact TRAIN windows only, StandardScaler on hidden and targets, multioutput Ridge alpha10, fixed in advance
physical_readouts.evaluation: contact window/recording error first; then radar recording mean of readout predictions; no instantaneous cross-modal pairing assumed
baselines: oracle true-class training contact descriptor mean
oracle true-class training teacher embedding mean passed through readout
physical_readouts.primary_metric: MAE divided by TRAIN target std, equal recording weighting; R2 and rank diagnostics descriptive only with 8 records
physical_readouts.gate: do not interpret a radar target as successfully transferred if heldout contact readout is not better than the class-only baseline for that target
limitations: contact data are intermittent within radar recordings
amplitude readouts may reflect mounting/gain rather than failure
only class-level training bags prevent identifying detailed within-class correspondence

other_controls.label_only_radar: TRAIN-only StandardScaler+LogisticRegression C1 on corrected frame_shape and nuisance feature sets; no teacher features; recording split unchanged
other_controls.external: bigNormal and keep excluded from fitting; keep not counted as a known class; predictions may be exported
other_controls.source_retention: no original encoder or head files changed; no newly trained readout claimed to pass public-task 0.5pp constraint
